scripts.//: outDir is relative to Vocs' rootDir, which resolves to the folder holding pages/ — here apps/docs/docs. The default therefore emitted to apps/docs/docs/dist, one level deeper than Railway's static builder copies from (/app/apps/docs/dist) and than turbo's `dist/**` outputs glob, so the deploy failed with 'not found' and turbo cached nothing. It is a CLI flag, not a vocs.config.ts key. `vocs preview` takes no options and always serves rootDir/dist, so it gets its own build at that path.
